c01-city.observed_description: A big city of towers seen from a hill, with two hands holding a phone in the lower-left corner.
c01-city.note: Rejected: the hands and the phone in the corner distract from the city and could be read as the subject. Remade in revision 2 with a prompt that rules them out.

c02-town.observed_description: A small town seen from a low hill: low stone houses with red tile roofs around one small square with a fountain, with green fields and hills right behind. No tall buildings.
c02-town.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

c03-road.observed_description: One long, straight, empty gray asphalt road with a white dashed centre line runs to the horizon through flat green fields under a blue sky. No cars or people.
c03-road.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

c04-market.observed_description: An open-air street market: wooden stalls under colored awnings piled with fruit and vegetables on both sides, with a few shoppers seen from behind walking between them.
c04-market.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

c05-building.observed_description: One modern office building with rows of identical windows stands alone against a clear blue sky, whole from the ground to the roof. No people.
c05-building.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

c06-map.observed_description: One unfolded paper street map lies flat on a wooden table, seen from above: a web of white and yellow streets, green areas and a blue river, with fold creases. No labels.
c06-map.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. The streets and areas carry no names; a faint mark in the bottom margin is not readable.
